title: I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry
title_zh: I2CD：面向模拟就绪碰撞几何的直接图像到凸分解方法

paragraphs.en: Physics simulators and motion planners require convex collision geometry, yet image-to-3D generative models output dense, frequently non-manifold visual meshes. Bridging the two today takes a slow, brittle reconstruct-then-decompose pipeline of repair, decimation, and approximate convex decomposition. We present I2CD, which predicts a convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image. Rather than train a new image-to-3D model, I2CD freezes the pretrained Hunyuan3D-2 image-conditioned diffusion transformer and shape decoder and trains only a lightweight cross-attention head (38 M parameters, under ten GPU-hours) whose learned “convex-slot” tokens emit the halfplane parameters of K K convex polytopes. The output is compact, convex by construction, and loads into physics engines without any post-processing, in ∼ 0.5 {\sim}0.5 s per image. On 227 227 held-out OmniObject3D and Google Scanned Objects instances, I2CD attains the highest volumetric IoU among eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines while running 6 6 – 37 × 37\times faster end-to-end. In a cross-simulator study in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, every engine uses I2CD geometry as delivered, whereas raw generated meshes “load” everywhere but are silently replaced by a different collision shape in most cases or need seconds to minutes of per-object preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, I2CD produces planner-ready geometry for a 20 20 -object cluttered scene in 11 11 s versus 328 328 s for the strongest baseline, at comparable pick-and-place execution success ( 85 85 vs. 90 90 of 100 100 trials).
paragraphs.zh: 物理模拟器和运动规划器需要凸碰撞几何结构，但图像到三维的生成模型输出的却是密集且经常是非流形的视觉网格。 目前，连接这两者需要一条缓慢且脆弱的“先重建后分解”流程，包括修复、降采样和近似凸分解等步骤。 我们提出了 I2CD，它可以直接从单张 RGB 图像预测出凸分解结构。 I2CD 并非训练一个新的图像到三维模型，而是冻结了预训练的 Hunyuan3D-2 图像条件扩散变换器和形状解码器，仅训练一个轻量级的交叉注意力头（3800 万个参数，训练时间不到十 GPU 小时），其学习到的“凸槽”令牌会输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数。 该输出结构紧凑、天生具有凸性，且无需任何后处理即可直接加载到物理引擎中，每张图像的处理时间约为 0.5 秒。 在 227 个预留的 OmniObject3D 和 Google Scanned Objects 实例上，I2CD 在八种“先重建后分解”的流程中获得了最高的体积交并比（IoU），同时端到端运行速度提升了 6 至 37 倍。 在 MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis 和 Isaac Sim 的跨模拟器研究中，所有引擎都能直接使用 I2CD 提供的几何结构；而原始生成的网格虽然几乎都能“加载”，但在多数情况下会被静默替换为不同的碰撞形状，或者需要每对象花费数秒到数分钟进行预处理。 在物理 xArm7 机械臂上，I2CD 为包含 20 个物体的杂乱场景生成规划就绪的几何结构仅需 11 秒，而最强的基线方法则需要 328 秒；同时，其抓取与放置任务的执行成功率也基本相当（100 次试验中分别为 85 次和 90 次成功）。

paragraphs.en: Robots plan and simulate on convex collision geometry. Sampling-based motion planners [ 1 , 2 ] , rigid-body simulators [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] , and contact-rich manipulation pipelines all rely on fast, robust proximity and penetration queries between convex bodies, computed with algorithms such as GJK and EPA [ 7 , 8 ] . Objects are therefore represented as convex decompositions , i.e., unions of convex parts that approximate a triangle mesh, and production simulators routinely build them with tools such as V-HACD [ 9 ] and CoACD [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 机器人基于凸碰撞几何进行规划和模拟。 基于采样的运动规划器 [ 1 , 2 ]、刚体模拟器 [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] 以及包含丰富接触操作的操控流程，都依赖于在凸体之间快速、稳健地执行邻近性和穿透性查询，这些查询通过 GJK 和 EPA [ 7 , 8 ] 等算法计算得出。 因此，物体被表示为凸分解，即由近似三角形网格的凸部分组成的并集，而生产级模拟器通常会使用 V-HACD [ 9 ] 和 CoACD [ 10 ] 等工具来构建这些分解。

paragraphs.en: Image-to-3D generative models now offer a direct route from a camera image to 3D geometry. The strongest methods sample a high-quality shape latent with a large image-conditioned diffusion or flow-matching model in a single feed-forward pass [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] , and robotics increasingly uses them to build scene geometry for manipulation and planning [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] . However, these models are optimized for visual fidelity, not physical simulation . They output dense triangle meshes ( ∼ 10 6 {\sim}10^{6} faces) with small but near-ubiquitous topological defects such as non-manifold edges and stray fragments (quantified in § IV-A ). Turning such a mesh into collision geometry takes a fragile chain of decimation [ 17 ] , repair [ 18 ] , watertightening, and approximate convex decomposition. This reconstruct-then-decompose workflow [ 15 ] is slow and sensitive to errors at every stage. Skipping it is worse, because it does not fail loudly: as we show in § IV-B , physics engines accept the raw mesh and silently substitute a single convex hull, producing a plausible-looking scene with the wrong collision shape.
paragraphs.zh: 图像到三维的生成模型现在提供了从相机图像直接生成三维几何结构的路径。 最强大的方法通过单次前向传播，使用大型图像条件扩散模型或流匹配模型采样出高质量的形状潜在表示 [ 11 , 12 , 13 ]，而机器人技术也越来越多地利用这些模型为操作和规划构建场景几何结构 [ 14 , 15 , 16 ]。 然而，这些模型针对的是视觉保真度进行优化，而非物理模拟。 它们输出的密集三角网格（约 10⁶ 个面）存在微小但几乎普遍存在的拓扑缺陷，例如非流形边和孤立碎片（在 § IV-A 中进行了量化）。 将这样的网格转换为碰撞几何结构需要一系列脆弱的处理步骤：降采样 [ 17 ]、修复 [ 18 ]、密封化和近似凸分解。 这种“先重建再分解”的工作流程 [ 15 ] 速度缓慢，且对每个阶段的错误都极为敏感。 跳过这一流程的情况更糟，因为它不会明显失败：正如我们在 § IV-B 中所示，物理引擎会接受原始网格，并静默地将其替换为一个单一的凸包，从而生成一个看似合理但碰撞形状错误的场景。

paragraphs.en: We propose I2CD ( I mage-to- C onvex- D ecomposition), which bypasses this workflow by predicting the convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image (Fig. 1 ). Our key insight is that the generator’s mesh is the wrong output but its features are the right input: a pretrained image-to-3D model already encodes the object’s shape, so only the readout needs to change. We therefore keep the image-conditioned diffusion transformer (DiT) and ShapeVAE decoder of Hunyuan3D-2 [ 11 ] frozen and replace the mesh readout with a lightweight cross-attention head. Its K K learned “convex-slot” tokens query the pretrained shape features, and each emits the H H halfplanes of one convex polytope in the CvxNet formulation [ 19 ] ; the union of the K K polytopes is the predicted shape. Only this head is trained, with a class-balanced occupancy loss and a convex-pair contrastive loss that suppresses the slab-stacking failure mode of CvxNet-style decoders.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 I2CD（图像到凸分解），它通过直接从单张 RGB 图像预测凸分解来绕过这一工作流程（图 1）。 我们的关键洞见是：生成器的网格是错误的输出，但其特征是正确的输入——预训练的图像到 3D 模型已经编码了物体的形状，因此只需改变读出部分即可。 因此，我们保持 Hunyuan3D-2 [11] 中的图像条件扩散变换器（DiT）和 ShapeVAE 解码器冻结不变，并将网格读出替换为一个轻量级的交叉注意力头。 其 K 个已学习的“凸槽”令牌会查询预训练的形状特征，每个令牌输出 CvxNet 公式 [19] 中一个凸多胞形的 H 个半平面；K 个多胞形的并集即为预测的形状。 仅该注意力头会被训练，使用类别平衡的占据率损失和凸对对比损失，以抑制类 CvxNet 解码器中的板层堆叠失效模式。

Our contribution is to show, and validate for robotics, that a modern image-to-3D foundation model becomes a direct source of simulation geometry with a 38 M-parameter head and under ten GPU-hours of training, inheriting an open-world shape prior that, to our knowledge, no image-to-convex model trained from scratch currently offers. paragraphs.en: Image-to-3D generation. Single-image reconstruction has progressed from template deformation [ 23 ] and implicit fields [ 24 , 25 ] to large feed-forward generators [ 26 , 27 ] built on diffusion [ 28 ] and flow matching [ 29 ] . The state of the art samples a compact shape latent [ 30 , 31 ] with an image-conditioned DiT and decodes it to a dense mesh [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Robotics has begun to use these models to build scene geometry from images [ 14 , 16 , 15 ] , but always through their mesh output followed by post-processing. We exploit an asymmetry in these systems: their meshes are unsuited to collision geometry, yet their pretrained shape decoders encode a rich, general-purpose geometric prior that a small head can read out into a different output modality.

paragraphs.en: Positioning. Closest in goal is SPARCS [ 15 ] , which estimates simulation-ready cluttered scenes by jointly optimizing the shapes and poses of a few objects (up to 5 5 , represented by up to 22 22 convex hulls in total) under a shape-differentiable contact model. SPARCS is a scene-level, optimization-based refinement that starts from learned per-object initializations and inherits their convex hulls. I2CD is an object-level, feed-forward source of exactly such convex geometry (in 0.5 0.5 s, for 20 20 -object scenes). The two are complementary: our output could initialize their optimization, while their physics-aware refinement could correct the pose-registration errors that dominate our robot failures (§ IV-C ). I2CD is, to our knowledge, the first method to adapt a pretrained image-conditioned 3D foundation model to directly output simulation-ready convex geometry. We keep the CvxNet halfplane representation and Yang et al.’s containment principle, but apply the contrastive loss directly to the per-convex soft responsibilities of our head, without an auxiliary feature field.
paragraphs.zh: 定位。 与目标最接近的是 SPARCS [ 15 ]，它通过联合优化少量物体（最多 5 个，总共由最多 22 个凸包表示）的形状和姿态，在形状可微分的接触模型下估算出可用于模拟的杂乱场景。 SPARCS 是一种基于优化的场景级精修方法，它以学习得到的每个物体的初始状态为起点，并继承这些初始状态的凸包。 I2CD 是一种物体级的前馈方法，能够直接生成此类精确的凸几何结构（对于包含 20 个物体的场景，耗时 0.5 秒）。 这两种方法互为补充：我们的输出可以为它们的优化提供初始化，而它们基于物理的精细调整则能纠正导致机器人失败的主要姿态配准误差（§ IV-C）。 据我们所知，I2CD 是第一种将预训练的图像条件 3D 基础模型进行适配，使其能够直接输出可用于模拟的凸几何结构的方法。 我们保留了 CvxNet 的半平面表示和 Yang 等人提出的包含原则，但将对比损失直接应用于我们模型中每个凸包的软责任度，而无需辅助特征场。

paragraphs.en: We use Hunyuan3D-2-mini [ 11 ] as a fixed backbone with two frozen components. paragraphs.en: Baselines. No open-world method predicts convex decompositions from an image (§ II ), so we compare to reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines that pair two image-to-3D models with four decomposers. The generators are HY3D (Hunyuan3D-2-mini [ 11 ] , 10 10 flow-matching steps, the same DiT we adapt) and SAM3D [ 13 ] . The classical decomposers are CoACD [ 10 ] , with concavity 0.05 0.05 and at most 12 12 hulls, and V-HACD [ 9 ] , with at most 12 12 hulls and resolution 10 5 10^{5} . All other parameters are library defaults (no decimation or vertex cap), and no mesh repair is applied unless stated. The learned decomposers are not mesh-cutting algorithms, so we specify their interface. CvxNet [ 19 ] consumes a 4,096 4{,}096 -point surface cloud sampled from the reconstructed mesh (normalized to [ − 0.5 , 0.5 ] 3 [-0.5,0.5]^{3} ) and is retrained on our MolmoSpaces training set, since no open-world weights exist. BSP-Net [ 20 ] consumes a 64 3 64^{3} occupancy voxelization and runs the official pretrained checkpoint with the official redundant-convex filtering. Runtimes include these conversions.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 没有任何开放世界方法能从图像中预测凸分解（§ II），因此我们将其与“先重建后分解”的流程进行比较，这些流程将两个图像到3D的模型与四个分解器组合使用。 生成器包括 HY3D（Hunyuan3D-2-mini [11]，10个流匹配步骤，与我们适配的 DiT 相同）和 SAM3D [13]。 经典的分解器包括 CoACD [10]（凹度为 0.05，最多包含 12 个外壳）和 V-HACD [9]（最多包含 12 个外壳，分辨率为 10^5）。 所有其他参数均使用库的默认设置（无采样削减或顶点上限），除非另有说明，否则不应用网格修复。 这些学习到的分解器并非网格切割算法，因此我们需明确其接口定义。 CvxNet [19] 需要输入一个从重建网格中采样的 4,096 点表面点云（归一化至 [-0.5, 0.5]^3），并在我们的 MolmoSpaces 训练集上重新训练，因为目前不存在开放世界的预训练权重。 BSP-Net [20] 需要输入一个 64^3 的占据度体素化结果，并使用官方预训练的检查点以及官方的冗余凸面过滤方法运行。 运行时间包含这些转换过程的时间。

paragraphs.en: Generated-mesh quality. The meshes these pipelines must decompose are far from clean. Of the 127 127 HY3D meshes (median 1.6 1.6 M faces), 98 % 98\% contain non-manifold edges (median 7 7 per mesh), only 2 % 2\% pass a watertightness test, 6 % 6\% have open boundaries, and 59 % 59\% consist of several components (median 3 3 , the extra ones being fragments with < 0.1 % {<}0.1\% of the vertices). These defects are small in extent, but they disqualify the mesh for tools requiring manifold input.

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Each prediction is aligned to its ground truth by centering, unit-diagonal scaling, PCA alignment over the four sign ambiguities, and 50 50 iterations of scale-enabled ICP [ 41 ] . We report volumetric IoU from 10 5 10^{5} uniform samples (containment at pitch extent / 64 \mathrm{extent}/64 ). The reference is the mesh itself for watertight GSO objects and its convex hull for open OmniObject3D scans; predictions always use their actual geometry. We also report symmetric L1 Chamfer distance (CD) and F-score at τ = 1 % \tau{=}1\% of the ground-truth extent on 10 4 10^{4} surface samples, and end-to-end runtime .
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 每次预测都通过中心化、单位对角线缩放、在四种符号歧义上的主成分分析（PCA）对齐，以及 50 次迭代的比例启用 ICP [41]，与对应的真实值进行对齐。 我们报告了来自 10^5 个均匀样本的体积交并比（IoU）（在俯仰范围 /64 \mathrm{extent}/64 内的包含关系）。 对于无缝 GSO 对象，参考数据是网格本身；对于开放的 OmniObject3D 扫描数据，参考数据是其凸包；预测始终使用其实际几何结构。 我们还报告了在 10^4 个表面样本上、τ = 1% \tau{=}1\% 的真实值范围下的对称 L1 Chamfer 距离（CD）和 F 分数，以及端到端的运行时间。

paragraphs.en: Per-dataset analysis. On the 100 100 watertight GSO objects, where IoU is exact, the margin widens to 5 5 – 9 9 points over every pipeline ( 68.9 68.9 vs. ≤ 63.8 % {\leq}63.8\% ); against SAM3D+CoACD, for which we hold per-object GSO results, a paired Wilcoxon test gives p = 0.017 p{=}0.017 . paragraphs.en: Surface metrics and mesh repair. Surface metrics favor methods that preserve local detail: SAM3D+CoACD has the best F-score and CD, at the highest IoU variance ( 20.2 % 20.2\% ), and I2CD trails its F-score by 3.6 3.6 points (§ V ). Mesh repair does not close the IoU gap to I2CD. SAM3D meshes add double layers and non-watertight components to the defects listed above. Repairing and simplifying them before CoACD (duplicate/non-manifold removal, hole filling, quadric decimation) raises IoU from 61.5 61.5 to 63.2 % 63.2\% , still below I2CD, while decomposition time more than doubles ( 6.1 → 13.8 6.1\to 13.8 s per object) because manifold inputs route CoACD to its slower exact path. Pre-processing narrows the quality gap only by widening the runtime gap.
paragraphs.zh: 表面度量和网格修复。 表面度量更青睐能够保留局部细节的方法：SAM3D+CoACD 在最高的 IoU 方差（20.2% 20.2\%）下取得了最佳的 F-score 和 CD，而 I2CD 的 F-score 则落后 3.6 3.6 分（§ V）。 网格修复未能缩小与 I2CD 之间的 IoU 差距。 SAM3D 网格在上述缺陷之上增加了双层结构和非密封组件。 在 CoACD 之前对这些结构进行修复和简化（移除重复/非流形部分、填充孔洞、四边形减面），可将 IoU 从 61.5 61.5 提升至 63.2% 63.2\%，但仍低于 I2CD；同时，由于流形输入会将 CoACD 引导至其较慢的精确处理路径，分解时间也翻了一番多（每个对象从 6.1 6.1 秒增至 13.8 13.8 秒）。 预处理仅通过扩大运行时差距来缩小质量差距。

paragraphs.en: “Simulation-ready” is usually asserted by showing that an asset loads. This is not enough: engines accept almost any mesh and, for dynamic bodies, silently replace non-convex geometry with a proxy. We therefore load the 127 127 OmniObject3D objects into MuJoCo [ 4 ] , PyBullet [ 3 ] , Genesis [ 6 ] , and Isaac Sim (PhysX) [ 5 ] . Ours is loaded as one convex hull per predicted part, the engines’ hull mode for mesh colliders. The raw HY3D mesh ( ∼ 2 {\sim}2 M faces) is loaded under each engine’s default mesh handling and, where offered, under its non-convex alternatives: PyBullet’s concave triangle mesh, PhysX’s signed-distance-field (SDF) collider, and PhysX’s built-in convex decomposition (V-HACD). Each object is normalized to 0.2 0.2 m, dropped from 0.1 0.1 m onto the ground, and simulated for 10 10 s at 2 2 ms steps. Genesis runs on CPU; its load times include per-scene kernel compilation.
paragraphs.zh: “可模拟”通常通过证明一个资产能够加载来确认。 但这并不足够：引擎几乎可以接受任何网格，而对于动态物体，它们会静默地将非凸几何体替换为代理模型。 因此，我们将 127 个 OmniObject3D 对象加载到 MuJoCo [4]、PyBullet [3]、Genesis [6] 和 Isaac Sim (PhysX) [5] 中。 我们的方法是将每个预测部分作为一个凸包进行加载，这对应于引擎中网格碰撞器的凸包模式。 原始 HY3D 网格（约 200 万个面）在每种引擎的默认网格处理机制下加载，并在支持的情况下使用其非凸替代方案：PyBullet 的凹三角网格、PhysX 的符号距离场 (SDF) 碰撞器以及 PhysX 内置的凸分解（V-HACD）。 每个物体都被归一化为 0.2 米，从 0.1 米的高度落到地面上，并以 2 毫秒的时间步长模拟 10 秒。 Genesis 在 CPU 上运行；其加载时间包含每场景的核函数编译时间。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Asset preserved is the fraction of objects whose engine-effective collision geometry has voxel IoU ≥ 0.9 \geq 0.9 with the asset as handed to the engine. paragraphs.en: Results. Table II exposes what “it loads” hides. (1) Default handling changes the shape : MuJoCo, PyBullet, and PhysX all replace the dynamic raw mesh by its single convex hull (PhysX logs a warning; the others are silent). This is the wrong collision shape for about 60 % 60\% of objects, and it is exactly the auto-hull geometry that fails 95 95 of 100 100 trials in § IV-C . The single hull is also a poor dynamic proxy: it keeps rocking on 16 16 – 21 % 21\% of objects in MuJoCo and PyBullet. (2) Built-in decomposition does not recover it : Genesis decimates to 500 500 faces and runs CoACD when the hull error exceeds 15 % 15\% (68 of 127 127 objects), i.e., it re-introduces the very pipeline we bypass, yet preserves the asset for only 40.2 % 40.2\% of objects while paying seconds of preprocessing per object. PhysX’s built-in V-HACD fares no better (26.8% preserved): approximate decomposition of a 2 2 M-face non-manifold mesh under engine defaults is not a substitute for clean input. (3) Non-convex colliders are exact but not free : PyBullet’s concave mode registers zero object–object contacts between dynamic bodies, so clutter cannot interact. PhysX’s SDF collider costs 3.75 3.75 s of cooking per object, crashes on 6 6 of them, and leaves 14 % 14\% of objects (mostly round fruit and balls) slowly rolling. Genesis’s SDF collider is prohibitive on these meshes (Table II , caption). (4) I2CD geometry is used as delivered : it needs no preprocessing in any engine and is preserved on ≥ 98.4 % \geq 98.4\% of objects everywhere (one consistent miss: a thin wall clock). It loads in tens to hundreds of milliseconds in MuJoCo, PyBullet, and PhysX, settles at sub-millimeter penetration, and comes to rest in ≥ 99.2 % \geq 99.2\% of drops (exception: a coiled belt creeping in MuJoCo).

paragraphs.en: We next test I2CD where it must ultimately work: planning and executing through clutter on a real robot. Per-object metrics miss that under-covered geometry permits unsafe plans, that over-thickened geometry (e.g., an inflated hull) blocks grasps and approach paths, and that every stage from capture to a planner-ready scene consumes planning budget.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们在 I2CD 上进行测试，这正是它最终必须实现的目标：在真实机器人上穿越杂乱环境进行规划与执行。 针对单个物体的指标未能发现以下问题：覆盖不足的几何结构会导致不安全的规划方案；过度加厚的几何结构（例如膨胀的外壳）会阻碍抓取和接近路径；此外，从抓取到生成可供规划器使用的场景的每个阶段都会消耗规划预算。

paragraphs.en: Setup and protocol. A calibrated RealSense on a 7-DoF UFactory xArm7 (Fig. 5 ) captures a single RGB-D frame of a tabletop with 20 20 household and tool objects. SAM3 [ 42 ] segments the image, each method predicts object-centric convex geometry from the masked crops, and the geometries are placed at their depth-registered poses in a MuJoCo scene with the same arm and a table plane (Fig. 4 ). Each of the 20 20 objects serves in turn as the pick target with the other 19 19 as obstacles. RRT-Connect [ 43 ] plans a four-phase approach → \to grasp → \to retreat → \to place motion in the 7-DoF configuration space with a 5 5 s timeout per phase, and the planned trajectory is executed on the physical robot . A trial succeeds only if all four phases are planned within budget and the execution completes the pick-and-place without collision; any IK, grasp-pose, planning, or execution failure counts as failure. Each target is repeated with 5 5 planner seeds, for 100 100 physical trials per method. We report the time t geom t_{\mathrm{geom}} to planner-ready geometry for all 20 20 objects, the one-time MuJoCo load time t load t_{\mathrm{load}} , and execution success; per-query collision-check time differs by ≤ 0.08 {\leq}0.08 ms across methods.
paragraphs.zh: 设置与协议。 一个校准好的 RealSense 摄像头安装在 7-DoF UFactory xArm7 机械臂上（图 5），捕捉到一张包含 20 个日常用品和工具物体的桌面 RGB-D 单帧图像。 SAM3 [42] 对图像进行分割，每种方法都从掩码裁剪区域中预测出以物体为中心的凸几何形状，并将这些几何体按照深度配准后的位姿放置在包含相同机械臂和桌面的 MuJoCo 场景中（图 4）。 这 20 个物体轮流作为抓取目标，其余 19 个则作为障碍物。 RRT-Connect [43] 规划了一个四阶段的方法：抓取 → 后退 → 放置，在 7-DoF 配置空间中执行，每个阶段设置 5 秒超时；规划出的轨迹随后在实体机器人上执行。 只有当所有四个阶段都在预算时间内完成规划，且执行过程无碰撞地完成了抓取与放置动作时，一次试验才算成功；任何逆运动学、抓取位姿、规划或执行中的失败均视为失败。 每个目标都使用 5 个规划器种子重复测试，每种方法共进行 100 次实体试验。 我们报告了为全部 20 个物体生成可供规划器使用的几何形状所需的时间 t_geom、一次性的 MuJoCo 加载时间 t_load，以及执行成功率；每次查询的碰撞检测时间在不同方法之间的差异 ≤ 0.08 ms。

paragraphs.en: Results. Table III reports the results. (1) Geometry quality gates task success : the single-hull baseline succeeds in only 5 / 100 5/100 trials, since inflated hulls block valid grasps and approach paths in clutter even though each hull is a faithful outer bound of its object. Multi-convex geometry succeeds in 90 / 100 90/100 (SAM3D+CoACD) and 85 / 100 85/100 (I2CD). The five-trial difference is not significant even if the 100 100 trials were independent (Fisher’s exact test, p = 0.39 p{=}0.39 ), and less so given that they are 5 5 seeds on each of only 20 20 configurations. The remaining failures trace mostly to pose-registration error shifting tightly packed obstacles into the grasp envelope, plus, for I2CD, slightly lower local surface fidelity from direct K = 12 K{=}12 prediction. (2) The pipeline, not the planner, is the bottleneck : I2CD delivers planner-ready geometry for the scene in 11 11 s versus 328 328 s for SAM3D+CoACD, a ∼ 30 × {\sim}30\times reduction ( ∼ 14 × {\sim}14\times against HY3D+CoACD, see above), while load and collision-check times are tied.

paragraphs.en: We presented I2CD, which adapts a frozen image-to-3D foundation model to emit convex collision geometry directly from a single RGB image. A 38 M-parameter head trained in under ten GPU-hours matches or exceeds eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines in volumetric IoU at 6 6 – 37 × 37\times lower latency. Its geometry is used as delivered by every engine and settles stably in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim without any preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, it cuts the time to a planner-ready cluttered scene by ∼ 30 × {\sim}30\times at comparable execution success. More broadly, pretrained 3D generators need not be used only through their meshes: their shape features are a substrate for robotics-specific heads that predict what downstream systems consume.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 I2CD，它能够将一个冻结的图像到 3D 的基础模型进行适配，从而直接从单张 RGB 图像生成凸碰撞几何结构。 一个参数规模为 3800 万的头网络，训练时间不到十 GPU 小时，其体素 IoU 性能与八种“先重建再分解”的流程相当甚至更优，而延迟则低 66–37×。 其几何结构可被所有引擎直接使用，并且无需任何预处理即可在 MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis 和 Isaac Sim 中稳定运行。 在实际的 xArm7 机械臂上，它在保持相似执行成功率的同时，将场景准备就绪所需的时间缩短了约 30 倍（{\sim}30×）。 更广泛地说，预训练的 3D 生成器并不仅限于通过其网格使用：它们的形状特征也可以作为机器人专用头网络的输入基础，用于预测下游系统所需的输出。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. I2CD inherits the errors of its frozen backbone (missed thin structures, hallucinated or over-smoothed parts), and the 3.2 3.2 -point IoU gap between mesh-encoded and image-sampled latents is entirely a backbone property. Both improve with stronger backbones, and the head is agnostic to which one is used. Surface fidelity trails volumetric fidelity: I2CD is 3.6 3.6 F-score points ( ∼ 19 % {\sim}19\% relative) behind the best pipeline, and the marching-cubes ablation shows this is a property of the K = 12 K{=}12 predicted geometry, not of export. For quasi-static planning this matters little. In contact-rich tasks such as non-prehensile pushing, where surface detail acts on every contact, it is the limitation most likely to bind; adaptive slot allocation and per-slot existence prediction are the natural remedies. Convex slots group geometry by proximity rather than semantics (they do not separate “seat” from “legs”). Finally, our real-robot study covers one tabletop scene and a quasi-static task. Although its 100 100 trials span 20 20 target/obstacle configurations, scenes with complex support relations and contact-rich tasks would test the geometry more stringently and are the natural next step.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 I2CD 继承了其冻结骨干网络中的错误（遗漏了精细结构，或出现了幻觉或过度平滑的部分），而网格编码潜变量与图像采样潜变量之间 3.2 个 IoU 点的差距完全源于骨干网络的特性。 使用更强大的骨干网络时，两者性能都会提升，且头网络对所用骨干网络的选择并不敏感。 表面保真度低于体素保真度：I2CD 的 F 分数比最佳流程低 3.6 分（相对差距约为 19%），而 marching-cubes 消融实验表明，这是 K = 12 的预测几何特性，而非导出环节的问题。 对于准静态规划而言，这一点影响不大。 在接触频繁的任务中（例如非抓取式推动任务），表面细节会影响每一次接触，因此这很可能是主要的限制因素；自适应槽位分配和每个槽位的存在性预测是自然的解决方案。 凸槽位根据几何形状的位置邻近性进行分组，而非语义特征（它们不会将“座椅”与“椅腿”区分开）。 最后，我们的真实机器人研究涵盖了一个桌面场景和一个准静态任务。 尽管其 100 次试验覆盖了 20 种目标/障碍物配置，但具有复杂支撑关系和频繁接触的场景任务会对几何结构提出更严格的考验，也是自然的下一步研究方向。
